description.value: Tim Hortons is Canada's iconic quick-service coffee and food chain, and this East Hastings Street location offers brewed coffee, specialty espresso drinks, baked goods, breakfast wraps, soups, and chili for dine-in or takeout. Situated on a major eastside arterial corridor, it is a practical mid-ride or end-of-day stop for cyclists moving through Vancouver's east end. The location has no drive-through, keeping the footprint pedestrian- and cyclist-friendly.

address.value: 3502 East Hastings Street, Vancouver, BC V5K 2A7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real, operating Tim Hortons at 3502 East Hastings St, Vancouver, with matching phone number and address. Website lists 'Take Out' and 'Dine-In' as explicit features, and OSM carries takeaway=yes. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenities appears in the website content, so those remain null. OSM opening_hours differ from what the website shows, flagged in concerns.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag (Mo-Su 06:00-20:00) does not match the hours shown on the business's own website — the website shows shorter and varying daily hours. OSM data should be updated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating, publicly accessible Tim Hortons with confirmed address, phone, and active location page. A practical food-and-drink stop for touring cyclists on East Hastings.
